full_name: CrossCountry ShiftApp – Train Manager Shift Log
data_policy: Shift details, trains and timestamped entries autosave locally in this browser using localStorage. Manual Save is also available. No server upload is configured.
update_policy: The app checks for updates on launch and at most once every 24 hours while open or when returning to the foreground. Updates use a versioned cache and do not clear locally saved shift data.
asset_layout: All image assets are stored in the application root directory.
features: Lost property capture: found/handed-in source, item, identifying description, location, optional person details and handover/storage destination; timestamped and included in shift exports.
Live CrossCountry station-style digital clock at the top of the page, showing UK local time and date with automatic GMT/BST handling.
LED-style CrossCountry digital clock with illuminated seven-segment-inspired digits.
Incident entries are created from Add issue / log entry; a custom prompt captures an optional incident log number.
Reference-matched seven-segment LED clock with lime main digits and red seconds
Reference-matched seven-segment LED clock with smaller red seconds digits
Removed sequential incident follow-up entries; added standalone Update entry type
High-legibility LED clock with wider bevelled segments, brighter illumination and improved mobile sizing
Clock changed to clear standard system digital numerals with tabular spacing
